system.description:
Soldiers are often mercenaries, bodyguards, or loyal retainers, but the role transcends profession. It is a calling to protect others. Many serve causes or crowns, but most follow people: those they are protectors, above all and no matter the odds. Soldiers stand fast when others flee.

STARTING EVASION: 9
STARTING HP: 7

Thematic Items

A keepsake from your mentor or a secret key

Soldier’s Hope Feature

Bulwark. Spend 3 Hope to clear 2 Armor Slots.

Archetype Feature

Unstoppable

Once per rest, you can declare yourself Unstoppable. You gain an Unstoppable Die - place it on your sheet with the 1 facing up. Each time you deal 1 or more Hit Points of damage, increase the die's value by 1. If the value would exceed the die’s maximum or the scene ends, remove the die and lose the Unstoppable state. While Unstoppable, you gain the following benefits:

  • Reduce the severity of physical damage by one threshold
  • Add the current value of your Die to damage rolls

Your Unstoppable die is a d4 at level 1, and d6 at level 5.

Combat Discipline

Once per combat scene, when you fail with Fear, you may mark a Stress to reroll your Hope die.
backgroundQuestions: Who did you fail to protect, and why do they still haunt your thoughts?
You were entrusted with something precious and dangerous. What is it, and what must you do?
There is something in yourself you see as a weakness. What is it, and how has it shaped your path?
connections: How did I save your life the first time we met?
What small gift did you give me that I always carry with me? Did I give you something in return?
What lie have you told me that I still believe without question?
